reasoning:
Looking at the renders, I notice the face reads badly—the nose blob and cheek blush band are too red and wide, making the face look like it has a muddled red mask rather than natural shading. I need to scale back the nose size and narrow/soften the cheek paint so the face doesn't look like a red rectangle under the eyes.

Otherwise the rest holds up: body proportions, pack, torso, hat brim with visible eyes, goggles, and base elements are all fine. I'll swap the skull paint to plain skin tone with subtler blush, and address why the mustache reads grey despite being colored white—probably shading from downward-facing normals.

I should also add rosy cheeks as small pink ellipsoid decals, positioning them slightly embedded into the skull surface near the cheek area so they look natural rather than floating.

Keeping the beard/mustache as is since it reads fine under brim shadow, but I'll bump up the nose size and give it a reddish tone. Eyebrows and arms are fine as-is, so now I just need to go edit the skullPaint block with these additions.
